ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: On the right side of the figure there is triangle GBC, G and C are on the same horizontal line GC, and B is located on the slanted line GA from G to A. There is a pink right-angle mark at B, indicating that BC is perpendicular to GA, so triangle GBC is right-angled at B. The problem gives m∠AGC = 40°, and angle 3 is marked at point C, that is, ∠GCB of triangle GBC. Reasoning: Because B is on GA, ray GB is in the same direction as ray GA, so ∠BGC = ∠AGC = 40°. In triangle GBC, ∠GBC = 90°, ∠BGC = 40°, so ∠3 = ∠GCB = 180° - 90° - 40° = 50°. The given m∠DGF = 53° is unrelated to finding ∠3.

raw_record.question_text: Find the measure of $\angle 3$ if $m\angle DGF = 53$ and $m\angle AGC = 40$.

method.method_draft: From the image, identify triangle GBC: point B lies on line GA, point C lies on horizontal line GC, and the pink right-angle mark at B shows BC is perpendicular to GA. Read from the text that m∠AGC = 40°. Since GB is along GA, ∠BGC is also 40°. Then use the triangle angle-sum rule in triangle GBC: ∠3 = 180° - 90° - 40° = 50°. The given m∠DGF = 53° is not needed.

method.method_draft: From the image, observe that GC is horizontal and GA forms the given angle ∠AGC with GC. Also observe that CB is drawn perpendicular to GA, as shown by the right-angle mark at B. Read from the text that ∠AGC = 40°. A line perpendicular to GA makes an angle complementary to 40° with GC, so the angle between CB and CG at C, labeled ∠3, is 90° - 40° = 50°. The 53° angle involving DGF is a distractor.
method.CoT_raw:
先描述图像：图中 GC 是底部水平线段，GA 是从 G 向右上方到 A 的斜线，题目给出 ∠AGC = 40°，即 GA 与 GC 的夹角为 40°。点 B 在 GA 上，线段 CB 与 GA 相交处有直角标记，说明 CB ⟂ GA。角 3 标在点 C 处，是 CB 与 CG 之间的角。另有 ∠DGF = 53°，但它位于左侧，与角 3 的求解无关。

再推理：因为 CB 垂直于 GA，所以 CB 与 GA 的夹角是 90°。又因为 GA 与 GC 的夹角是 40°，所以 CB 与 CG 形成的角 3 是 90° - 40° = 50°。因此，∠3 = 50°。
